column6: Live senior AI engineer posting on company own board for Park City role, confirmed open as of check date.
Sword Health announced $285M acquisition of Kaia Health on 2026-01-28, expanding platform reach.
SymbioCellTech received 2025 Levine-Riggs Symposium Scientific Achievement Award for Neo-Islets, announced 2025-11-18.
Live site reliability engineer posting on company own applytojob board for St. George role, confirmed open as of check date.
Red Cat (Teal Drones parent) announced $2.49M USAF order for Black Widow systems 2026-07-30, delivery due Aug 2026.
Techcyte announced a $15M capital raise led by Van Tuyl Companies with Zoetis and Mayo Clinic participating, closed 2026-04-30.
Live Scientist (SLC location) posting on company own Ashby board, confirmed via search as of check date.
IotaComm and TELLUS announced a strategic sensor-network partnership 2025-05-20; Crunchbase also lists a seed round dated 2025-07-01.
Most recent IRS Form 990 (FY ending June 2025) filed 2025-11-12, per ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer; org also maintains a live job board.
KUER/Utah Investigative Journalism Project published a dated report on the academy's program on 2026-06-14, confirming ongoing operation.
Communications Biology paper on MATCH/COMPASS published 2026-07-13; corresponding authors Gambles and Kendell are Thera-T principals.
Trinity Capital announced up to $35M equipment financing on 2026-04-30 to expand GigaOne manufacturing; company careers board also listed 33 live Utah roles as of check date.
TechBuzz reported $1.25M seed close 2025-05-29; company careers page still lists named engineering and sales openings as of check date.
USANA filed Form 10-Q on 2026-08-13 for the quarter ended 2026-07-04, reporting ongoing nutritional, Hiya, and Rise operations.
Utah bought Rowley land and water rights for lake restoration rather than magnesium production; plant idled since 2021 and the company is in chapter 11 liquidation.
Company announced a limited PDC IP license to Haimingrun on 2026-01-13 after an ITC dispute; work continues under LongRange after the July 2025 ChampionX sale.
CIB education page lists Biotechnology Summer Academy for 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-10 plus a Fall 2026 seminar series and a 2026 SURE undergraduate research cycle.
Utah Arch paper FlexProf (Minton and Balasubramonian) was on the ASPLOS 2025 program, Day 3 Side Channels session, 2025-04-03 in Rotterdam.
Utah Film Commission production page dated its incentive explainer 2026-08-05; April 2025 FAQ still lists monthly MPIP/CFIP application windows on the 10th.
Lab announced a Meta Neural Band accessibility collaboration on 2026-01-28; also posted a $940K upper-limb exoskeleton clinical-trial contract on 2025-08-01.
